- SOC 2 status: can you confirm current attestation date and whether Redwood's Private offering is covered by the same report?
- GDPR/HIPAA: do you have any HIPAA-specific controls for Private deployments or references in the compliance pack?
- Deployment diagrams: can you share a high-level VPC diagram and on-prem/air-gapped architecture options (subnets, NAT/egress, private control plane)?

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — VPC/on-prem options and SQ kickoff

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Appreciate the SQ attached; we'll start populating. Answers inline and next steps below: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II examination in January 2027 (report period: Jul 2026 - Dec 2026). Our Hosted and Dedicated offerings are covered by the SOC 2. For Private (VPC and on-prem) customers, we provide a SOC 2 addendum and package that documents customer isolation controls and deployment responsibilities — we'll include the addendum and a short summary.

- GDPR / HIPAA: Redwood maintains GDPR controls in our data processing addendum; we also have a HIPAA-ready posture and offer a BAA for customers that need it. For Private deployments, customers control egress and data residency; we document recommended controls in the deployment guide.

- Deployment diagrams: attaching a high-level VPC diagram (redwood-vpc-deployment-diagram.pdf) showing control plane connectivity options, optional NAT egress, and an air-gapped on-prem pattern. Note: air-gapped deployments are implemented via our on-prem bundle + local key management (HSM/KMS) and do not require outbound internet for inference once installed.

- SQ ownership: Monica (cc'd) will lead the questionnaire responses; Rachel will support with compliance artifacts. Monica will reach out with the first pass and request any clarifying questions.

Proposed next steps:
1) Monica to upload a completed SQ draft by Tue 3/30
2) Technical deep-dive (infra): propose Wed 3/31 10am PT — remote call w/ our infra lead to walk the diagram and network controls
3) We'll share SOC 2 summary & BAA template by EOD 3/26

If that timeline works, we'll book the technical call and start filling the questionnaire.

Best,
Marcus Lin
